name: sdg17
title: SDG 17: Partnerships for the goals (SDG Atlas of Bolivia 2026)
description: The SDG 17 (Partnerships for the goals) index of the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026 (SDSN Bolivia) and the 2 indicators behind it, for Bolivia's 343 municipalities and indigenous autonomies (GAIOC), at two points in time: near the 2012 census and near the 2024 census, stored as 2012 and 2024 so that their change can be studied.

geo:notes: Both periods are stored at nominal years: 2012 for the Atlas's initial values (~2012) and 2024 for its final values (~2024). Each indicator's actual reference years differ (e.g. 2008 and 2023 for the health survey, three-year averages for volatile indicators) and are given in its description and in `geo:reference_years`.
Load one variable in both periods, e.g. `geo.load("sdg17", variables="index_sdg17", names=True)`, and its change per unit with `geo.change(df, "index_sdg17")`.

The units are the 343 municipalities and indigenous autonomies (GAIOC) of 2025. Four of them were created after the 2012 census (TIOC-Raqaypampa, San Pedro de Macha, TIOC-Jatun Ayllu Yura and TIOC-Territorio Indígena Multiétnico); the Atlas gives them values in both periods.

Aggregating to provinces, departments or Bolivia (`geo.aggregate`, `geo.combine`) averages the municipal values weighted by census population (`weighted_mean:population`; the 2012 census for ~2012 and the 2024 census for ~2024, loaded from the `sdg` dataset through `geo:weights`): e.g. `geo.aggregate(geo.load("sdg17"), to="department", dataset="sdg17")`. These are population-weighted approximations, not the Atlas's own department figures.

fields.name: geo_id
fields.title: Municipality ID
fields.description: GDO-Bolivia municipality geo ID (BO-DD-PP-MM) of the 343-unit municipality map (SDSN Bolivia 2025: municipalities and indigenous autonomies), numbered as in GADM 4.1 plus four units created since; map343; its boundary is in geo/boundaries/map343. It nests by prefix into the department (BO-DD) and province (BO-DD-PP) IDs; department and province numbers follow GADM order and differ from INE codes.

fields.name: year
fields.title: Period
fields.description: Period of the values in the row: 2012 holds the Atlas's initial values (near the 2012 census) and 2024 its final values (near the 2024 census). Each variable's actual reference years are given in its description and in geo:reference_years.

fields.name: mun_id
fields.title: INE municipality code
fields.description: Official municipality code of the National Statistics Institute (INE), DDPPMM (department, province, municipality) stored as an integer without the leading zero (e.g. 20101 = Nuestra Señora de La Paz), as in the Atlas. The Atlas's rows are linked to geo_id through this code.

fields.name: index_sdg17
fields.title: Partnerships for the goals index (0-100)
fields.description: SDG 17 (Partnerships for the goals) index of the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026, on a 0-100 scale where 100 means the goal's targets are met and 0 the worst situation. Following the global SDG Index of SDSN, each of its 2 indicators is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between a worst and a best value (given in each indicator's description), with the direction set so that higher is always better and values beyond the bounds capped; the index is the simple mean of the available rescaled indicators. Components: Municipal revenue from local sources (%); Public investment (Bs per person). Initial value (~2012) stored at 2012 and final value (~2024) at 2024; its components refer to different years around each census. Atlas: “Índice ODS17”.
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg17_1_iil
fields.title: Municipal revenue from local sources (%)
fields.description: Percentage of municipal revenue that comes from local taxes and the municipality's other own sources, averaged over three years. Source: the Ministry of Economy and Public Finance (MEFP). Initial value average 2011–2013 (stored at 2012) and final value average 2021–2023 (stored at 2024). Missing for 10 of the 343 units in the initial period and 1 in the final one. In the SDG 17 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 0 (worst, 0) and 51.7 (best, 100), higher is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 50 and major challenges from 10 on. Atlas indicator 17_01_02_01_iil, “Porcentaje de ingresos municipales provenientes de fuentes locales” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg17_18_ipc
fields.title: Public investment (Bs per person)
fields.description: Executed public investment per person, at constant prices (deflated with the GDP deflator of public administration). Source: the Ministry of Economy and Public Finance (MEFP), executed investment budget. Initial value 2012 (stored at 2012) and final value 2023 (stored at 2024). Missing for 4 of the 343 units in each period. In the SDG 17 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 0 (worst, 0) and 1,526 (best, 100), higher is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 1,000 and major challenges from 250 on. Atlas indicator 17_18_01_02_ipc, “Inversión pública (Bs./persona)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
